hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: Deducts a configurable percentage (up to 10%) of input currency from each swap as a tax, routing 99% to a project treasury and 1% to a factory protocol fee recipient. Supports per-direction buy/sell tax decay schedules anchored on trading activation, a ramping max-buy cap enforced in afterSwap, and governance-gated trading. Exact-output swaps are not supported.
